gloss: to model after; to pattern after; to imitate the shape of

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {象|かたど}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to model after, to pattern after, to imitate the shape of
definitions.explanation: To create something by copying or representing the form or shape of something else.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{象|かたど}った⟦アクセサリー→アクセサリー：01761_akusesarii⟧。
examples.english: An accessory shaped like a flower.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{象|かたど}ったものだ。
examples.english: This character is modeled after the shape of a mountain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{象|かたど}った⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧になっている。
examples.english: A cake modeled after a famous building has become a topic of conversation.

notes:
Etymology: from {形|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take the shape of). The standard kanji is {象|かたど}る, but it can also be written as {模|かたど}る.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{象|かたど}った＋⟦{名詞|めいし}→名詞：10420_meishi⟧: something shaped/modeled after ...
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{象|かたど}る: to imitate the shape of ...

USAGE: Often used in the past-participle form {象|かたど}った as a modifier (e.g., ⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{象|かたど}った⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧). Common in art, design, and descriptions of kanji origins.
